## pyffmpegcore {{ tag }}: source-aware target-size planning

PyFFmpegCore remains a local-first beta. FFmpeg and FFprobe stay explicit
system dependencies. This patch accounts for source audio streams when
estimating two-pass target-size budgets.

### What changed

- Video-only inputs no longer reserve target bytes for an absent audio stream.
- Video-only inputs no longer require an audio encoder for two-pass compression.

### Verification

- Exact release artifact checks on Linux, macOS, and Windows with Python 3.10
  and 3.14: [release workflow]({{ release_run_url }})
- [Exact-size compression guide](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/exact-size/)
- [Full changelog](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/pyffmpegcore/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2)

Target-size estimates depend on the input streams and codec behavior. A size
target does not guarantee perceptual quality; inspect the result for your media.
